how.title: How it works
how.sub: Simple for shoppers, simple for sellers
how.1d: Browse clothing from different shops in one place. Filter by category and price.
how.2d: Put items from several sellers in one cart and pay once, securely.
how.3d: Each seller ships their own items. Follow your order from your account.
